Topic 3.8: Food Safety Handling of cooked food

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Food Safety Handling of cooked food. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

2. Explain Food Safety Handling of cooked food to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Food Safety Handling of cooked food.

5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

1. Write five sentences about Food Safety Handling of cooked food. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Food Safety Handling of cooked food important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
